title.en: the vancouver flea market on terminal ave.
title.de: der vancouver flea market an der terminal avenue.

line.en: the weekend flea at 703 terminal ave, open saturday and sunday. sunday mornings are the calm hours; go early.
line.de: der wochenend-flohmarkt in der terminal avenue 703, samstag und sonntag offen. sonntagvormittags ist es am ruhigsten, also früh hin.
line.tr: terminal ave 703'te hafta sonu flea market, cumartesi ve pazar açık. pazar sabahları en sakin saatler, erken gidin.

sparks.why: Vancouver Flea Market, 703 Terminal Ave, weekend hours listed as Sat and Sun 9:00 to 16:30 (Hotels.com guide) or 9:00 to 17:00 (another guide, undated). Hours may be out of date; check before going.
